context: A countryside man and his aunt discuss regional moves
purpose: Teach: 乗客/運賃/航空機/住居/富山/青森/秋田/茨城

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 叔母さん、聞いてくださいよ。来月、ついに青森から富山県に引っ越すことになりました。
lines.en: Auntie, listen to this. Next month, I'm finally moving from Aomori to Toyama Prefecture.
lines.style: Excited but slightly nervous countryside man sharing big news warmly

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あら、本当に?青森のりんご農家を継ぐ話はどうなったの?
lines.en: Oh my, really? What happened to the story about taking over the Aomori apple farm?
lines.style: Surprised middle-aged aunt gently probing with concerned curiosity

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 兄に任せることにしました。富山の薬売りの家系に縁があって、向こうで新しい仕事を始めるんです。
lines.en: I decided to leave it to my brother. I have ties to a Toyama medicine seller family and will start new work there.
lines.style: Calm reflective explanation, country-accented honest tone

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 遠いわねえ。秋田の温泉に寄ってから行きなさいよ。茨城県の従兄弟も会いたがってたわ。
lines.en: That's so far. Stop by the Akita hot springs on the way. Your cousin in Ibaraki Prefecture wanted to see you too.
lines.style: Warm motherly aunt suggesting travel route with family affection

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: それがですね、航空機で一気に飛ぶつもりなんです。新幹線より運賃が安い便を見つけまして。
lines.en: Well, actually I plan to fly by plane in one go. I found a flight cheaper than the bullet train.
lines.style: Practical countryside man explaining travel logistics matter-of-factly

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: へえ、最近は乗客も増えて格安便が多いらしいわね。でも住居はもう決まったの?
lines.en: Hmm, I hear passengers have increased lately and there are many cheap flights. But have you decided on housing?
lines.style: Aunt showing modern awareness while pivoting to practical concerns

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ええ、会社の近くに小さな一軒家を借りました。畑も付いていて、田舎暮らしを続けられそうです。
lines.en: Yes, I rented a small house near the company. It comes with a field, so I can keep up rural life.
lines.style: Contented countryside speaker reassuring family about rooted lifestyle

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: それなら安心したわ。落ち着いたら、お土産持って遊びに行くからね。
lines.en: Then I'm relieved. Once you settle in, I'll come visit with souvenirs.
lines.style: Warm closing reassurance from caring aunt promising future visit
